text:
sara: FYI Mediwave sent back the security questionnaire. Main asks: confirm SOC2 scope for nonprod masking, embddg retention window, and upload of attestation PDF. They put renewal at medium-risk until answered.
jules: got it. is this the same org that used the sandbox cluster last month?
sara: yes, mediwave-sbx and mediwave-prod. their auditor wants explicit masking attestation for sbx.
marco: quick note: nonprod uses tokenization + bcrypt pseudonyms for identifiers. embeddings are stored in a restricted bucket. retention default = 90 days. can provide evidence.
priya: legal: we have an attestation template but need engineering to confirm exact controls. Also need to know if customer requested different retention for embeddings (BYO addendum?).
jules: i'll pull config and a redacted example of the masking job. should be quick. onboard-bot: Artifact available -> s3://onboarding-evidence/mediwave/masking_job_redacted.tar.gz :link: 
sara: auditor asked for file path + sample log showing masking ran before data copy. can we produce a redacted log snippet?
marco: yes. sample log lines:
```
2026-04-01T02:14:10Z MASKING_JOB mediwave-sbx started
2026-04-01T02:14:55Z FIELD:patient_id pseudonymized -> token_4f3a
2026-04-01T02:15:12Z EMBEDDINGS: stored to s3://embeddings-medivave/sbx/2026-04-01/ (redacted)
```
marco: i'll redact PII and attach.
jules: also need to confirm embedding retention policy text for the DPA answer. draft suggestion:
"Embeddings derived from customer content are retained for up to 90 days in non-production environments unless the customer signs an extension addendum."
priya: legal tweak: replace 'signed' -> 'executes an addendum' and add a sentence about authorized signatories.
sara: schedule a 30m sync? the customer gave EOD Tue as deadline.
jules: available 10:30 PT. marco?
marco: yes 10:30.
onboard-bot: Reminder: evidence upload checklist -> https://redwood.internal/playbooks/evidence-upload :clipboard:
priya: once engineering attaches the redacted logs + config i'll run attestation template and add legal language. then ben (acct_owner) can upload.
sara: thanks team. i'll ping Mediwave PM once we have the docs. keeping renewal status = watching until delivered. :eyes:
